text: Everything the courts are fighting over about your phone gets thinner in one place. The border.
provenance: And there is one place where even this fragile protection gets thinner still: the border.

text: At an airport, or a crossing, the normal rules bend. For years the government has claimed it can search your phone there with no warrant at all.
provenance: At an airport, or a crossing, the normal rules bend. For years the government has claimed it can search your phone there with no warrant at all

text: And the courts cannot agree how far that power goes. Some say officers need at least a reason to suspect you. Others say they need nothing.
provenance: the courts cannot agree on how far that power goes. Some say officers need at least a reason to suspect you. Others say they need nothing.

text: In 2023, one federal judge became the first to rule the government does need a warrant to search a phone at the border. A real crack in the wall.
provenance: In 2023, one federal judge became the first to rule that the government does need a warrant to search a phone at the border — a real crack in the wall.

text: That ruling binds almost no one yet. So the same device that is a fortress in your living room can become an open book the moment you land.
